0022600230.text: The Phoenix Suns (4-6, 11th in the West) are at home for their 11th game of the season, having gone 4-3 at home and 0-3 on the road, and they're on a one-game winning streak. The Charlotte Hornets (4-7, 9th in the East) are 3-7 over their last ten and 1-3 on the road, also on a one-game winning streak. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury (surgery), while Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel are out for Charlotte, and Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions; the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Suns losing 127-107 in Charlotte on April 2, 2026.
